def solve(case):
    items = list(case['items'])
    required = case['required_failure_items']
    attempts = 0
    g = 2
    while True:
        if g > len(items):
            g = 1
        changed = False
        for i in range(0, len(items), g):
            end = min(i+g, len(items))
            candidate = items[:i] + items[end:]
            attempts += 1
            if all(f in candidate for f in required):
                items = candidate
                changed = True
                g += 1
                break
        if changed:
            continue
        # no change
        if g == 1:
            break
        g *= 2
        if g >= len(items):
            g = 1
    # compute one_minimal: check each item
    one_minimal = True
    for i in range(len(items)):
        candidate = items[:i] + items[i+1:]
        if all(f in candidate for f in required):
            one_minimal = False
            break
    return {"attempts": attempts, "one_minimal": one_minimal, "reduced_items": items}
